detail.title: FG1000 Gold V2 80 Plus Gold Full Modular Power Supply Unit
detail.overview: The Ant Esports PSU FG1000 Gold V2 Full Modular is a high-performance 1000W power supply built for enthusiast gaming PCs and professional workstations. Featuring 80 Plus Gold certification, ATX 3.1 & PCIe 5.1 compliance, and a fully modular design, it delivers outstanding power efficiency, superior cable management, and rock-solid stability. Equipped with a native 600W 12VHPWR connector, along with multiple CPU, PCIe, SATA, and Molex connectors, it's the perfect choice for powering flagship graphics cards and demanding high-end PC builds.
